newsitem.title: USA: Authentic Fitness Q4 shr drops to $1.77 loss.
newsitem.headline: Authentic Fitness Q4 shr drops to $1.77 loss.

text.p: 12 months ending July 6 12 months ending July 1
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: For the year, the company recorded, in the fourth quarter, a $15.5 million pre-tax charge for the exiting of its skiwear division, a $12.4 million pre-tax charge for the exiting of its outlet store division and a $2 million terminated merger related expense.
During the third quarter, as previously reported, the company took an $11.6 million Herman's bad debt write-off.

The company said it completed an extensive evaluation of its accounts receivable and inventory in connection with its year-end closing and, as a result, is providing additional reserves of $18.8 million, which relate to and will be reflected in the company's fiscal year 1996 second and third quarter results.

These one-time primarily non-cash charges, partially offset by a net $18.4 million income tax benefit, resulted in a net loss for the year of $40.85 million, or $2.08 per share. In the 1995 fiscal year, the company reported net income of $19.47 million, or $0.90 per share, on net revenues of $266.1 million.

Operating figures for the fourth quarter this year were a $13,169,000 net loss, equivalent to a per share loss of $0.64, compared to an operating net profit of $6,980,000 equal to $0.32 per share for a year ago.
